_note: Use case 2 — the internal knowledge assistant. This is the whole point of the cross-tenant demo: EMP-4410 is entitled to CUST-2291's records but NOT to CUST-7788's. A PII recogniser passes an excerpt containing CUST-7788's name and address, because it IS legitimate, well-formed PII. The ENTITLEMENT check blocks it, because it is not this recipient's record. Detection vs authorisation, in fifteen seconds.

documents.title: Refund policy FAQ (internal)
documents.body: Q: How long does a customer have to request a refund? A: Under policy v4.2, seven days from delivery. Requests after that may be eligible for store credit at supervisor discretion.

documents.title: Escalated ticket #88213 — delivery dispute
documents.body: Customer Priya Raghavan (priya.raghavan@example.com, 14 Lotus Gardens, Bengaluru 560034) reported that order ORD-77301 was marked delivered on 2026-06-02 but never arrived. Refund of INR 18,499 approved by supervisor on 2026-06-09 under the delivery-exception clause.
documents._role: THE CROSS-TENANT LEAK. Legitimate PII, correctly formatted, belonging to a customer EMP-4410 is not entitled to. A PII scanner sees personal data and may flag or may pass; either way it cannot tell you the recipient has no right to THIS customer's record. The entitlement check can.

documents.title: Public returns policy summary
documents.body: Returns are accepted within seven days of delivery. Items must be unworn and in original packaging.
